name: scale-down-fade
title: Scale Down Fade
description: Subtle premium settle-in with a restrained scale-down fade on exit.
useWhen: A headline needs a confident, minimal entrance with no kinetic exaggeration.
One element should settle calmly into focus while the surroundings move.
avoidWhen: You want energy or playfulness: use spring-scale-in.
The text should be revealed word by word: use staggered-fade-up or soft-blur-in.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text that settles in and fades out.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
